title: mdtools configuration
description: Configuration of the mdtools command of mdrefine: https://viell-dev.github.io/slop-markdown-tools/configuration.html

$schema.description: The JSON Schema for editors; the tool ignores it.

resolve.description: Files that links may lead to, which are never linted or formatted.

gitIgnored.description: Files that .gitignore files exclude are link targets. Default: false.

nestedRepositories.description: Files of nested Git repositories are link targets. Default: false.

extends.description: Presets to start from, in order: a preset name or a list of them. Without it, the configuration starts from recommended.

ignore.description: Path patterns of documents that are never linted or formatted. They stay link targets.

plugins.description: Plugins to load: files relative to this file, or package names.

overrides.description: Settings for the documents that match one of the patterns in files.

files.description: Path patterns, matched against paths relative to the workspace root.

dialect.description: The renderer whose syntax documents are read in. When nothing names one, github is assumed, or obsidian inside a vault.

rules.description: Rule IDs and their settings: a severity, or a list of a severity and the rule's options, as in ["warn", { "width": 100 }].
